test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends, J, K, L, M, N and O, are sitting in a straight line, facing north. L sits second to the left of M, who sits to the immediate left of K. J sits to the immediate left of N. L does not sit on any of the extreme ends. Who sits second to the right of O?
solution:
Six friends, J, K, L, M, N and O, are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

 
• L sits second to the left of M, who sits to the immediate left of K.
 
• J sits to the immediate left of N.
 
• L does not sit on any of the extreme ends

The Final Arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9619934964c8e7173c04c6bb7773c584a364937bcad0c130a35b49d1209d6298.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
